summary: Filter present elements using JavaScript truthiness while preserving iteration side effects and producing a dense result.

target.notes: Snapshot length, skip absent indices using property-presence checks, invoke callback via JsFunction.Call, apply JsValue.IsTruthy to its result, and append selected values densely to a builtin Array result.

semantics.callback_callable_check: TypeError before iteration if callback is not callable

caveats: Custom Symbol.species is owned by array.custom-species.runtime.
C# Where cannot represent JS truthiness or sparse-array presence without additional lowering.

tests.name: skips holes and compacts selected values
tests.input: const a=[1,,2,3]; const seen=[]; const r=a.filter((v,i)=>{seen.push(i);return v>1}); console.log(seen.join(','),r.join(','),r.length);

tests.name: appends after start are ignored
tests.input: const a=[1,2]; const r=a.filter((v,i)=>{if(i===0)a.push(3); return true}); console.log(r.join(','));
